note: Enemy rosters per Nexus event-map node (124 maps / 644 nodes). The original HoDA served Nexus node contents from EA servers; nothing per-node is client-side, so every squad here is RECONSTRUCTED, not extracted - authenticity is "inferred" throughout: the event family named by the map id and the node's battle_environment are evidence for the enemy TYPES, the exact squad is composed. Generated by scratchpad/build_nexus_rosters.py from client-additional-data/data_tables/nexus_maps.json. One base squad per event family (36 of them), expressed as rarity-ascending front/back/giant unit pools plus a named boss unit; the map id's difficulty prefix picks the band in those pools AND the tier/level ladder, the step ramps the level. LADDER (band = index into the pools, 0 = weakest): Easy band 0, tier I, level 4 +2/step; Medium band 1, tier II, level 10 +2/step; Hard band 2, tier III, level 22 +2/step; VeryHard band 3, tier IV, level 40 +3/step; Insane band 4, tier IV, level 62 +3/step; Ludicrous band 4, tier IV, level 74 +2/step. The bands track the two objective difficulty signals in the source table - step-1 energy_cost (5/15/25/40/60/60) and the award's unit_rarity_preview - and each level band sits under the catalog max_level of the rarity its band lands on. BOSS NODES (node.boss == true, or - for maps with no flagged boss - the map's last step): tier bumped one step (capped at IV), level +6/+6/+6/+8/+10/+12 by difficulty, a giant in slot 4, and the family's named unit in slot 1 (slot 4 when that unit is itself a giant). SQUAD SIZE: 3 non-giant cells at Easy/Medium, 4 from Hard up; boss nodes always 4 + giant; a non-boss node gets a giant only from VeryHard up and then only from step 3 on (plus the two Giant_* events, where every node has one). Slot layout matches campaign_rosters.json: 0/2 = back row (ranged, casters), 1/3 = front row (melee), 4 = giant; a 3-unit squad fills 0/1/3. Every level is clamped to the unit's catalog max_level for its tier. A boss node whose named unit has weaker catalog stats than the escort it displaced re-rolls with the family's hardest-hitting escort, so the boss node is the hardest fight on its map; three nodes (Insane UrnOfSacredAshes 6, Insane Halloween_2015 6, Ludicrous MaskedMayhem 5) still come in under a regular node on raw power+health because HoDA's legendary tier has a huge stat spread - they remain the highest-level fight on their map.
